config.data.title: The Awakening: Neo's Echo
config.data.description: A strange signal has been detected in the Mega City. Investigate its source.

objective1.description: Meet with the Oracle's contact in the Slums.
objective1.dial: I have been waiting for you. The signal is coming from the old subway station. Beware the Agents.

objective4.description: You have proven your worth. Embrace the rebirth.
